rawContent: Such a sad situation. These events have to stop. @NatGeoMag this month has a great analysis of the issue and possible solutions. #BLM https://t.co/QmYyqXVygt

Listening to the #BLM marches after #StephonClark shooting, it occurs to me this is a convergence of racial implicit bias and an over proliferation of guns. The police fear guns, but angry white men carry most of them. Their bias is misplaced, it appears. We must make it stop.
